== Constructed pools ==

From the 2009 reorganization to the 2014 reset, the Players Committee's constructed format (its "standard" format) was every Decipher card plus every virtual card released so far, so the pool grew with each release.<ref name="reset-std">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Players Committee, Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11) (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive]</ref> This wiki gives each dated pool its own page. Each page gives its sources; where a legal date is not known the page says so.

The 9.2 release, [[Twilight Of The Republic (Virtual Block 9)|Twilight Of The Republic]], has a PDF dated 14 July 2014, but on 25 July 2014 the Players Committee said it "will not be released in its current form"; no legal date for it was found.<ref name="reset-std" /> After the reset the pre-reset cards became the fixed Legacy format, [[Legacy Open]].<ref name="reset-std" /><ref name="afg" />
